title.en: Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Assignment of Functions) (No. 3) Notification 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Assignment of Functions) (No. 3) Notification 2020 and is deemed to have come into operation on 1 September 2020.

2. The Minister for Finance assigns to the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore the function of administering the Jobs Growth Incentive introduced in the Ministerial Statement on Continued Support for Workers and Jobs dated 17 August 2020.
